notes.title: Match Stats, Visual Upgrades, Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Patch v0.5 has dropped!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44315744/8390adfa178f8b0e25c883c3c9a8d49e964189b1.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44315744/8390adfa178f8b0e25c883c3c9a8d49e964189b1.gif[/img][/url]

This patch focuses mostly art.  We've jammed in a lot more awesome environment art to make the game feel more polished and hellish.  Release approaches very soon.

[h2]PATCHNOTES:[/h2]
- (update) add match stats
- (update) add more animation/life to level design
- (update) towers now leave behind a smoldering fire when destroyed
- (update) update art for loading screen
- (update) update art for Victory/Defeat popup
- (update) update art for Stephen E
- (update) clean up center of map art
- (update) fix center map art again
- (update) slightly zoom out gameplay camera

- (bug) fix a bug with post game screen Exit button being hard to click
- (bug) Fix visuals in Leo passive

notes.title: Graphics Update, UI Update, Global Chat
notes.notes:
[h2]PATCHNOTES:[/h2]

Patch v0.4 has dropped!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44315744/8390adfa178f8b0e25c883c3c9a8d49e964189b1.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44315744/8390adfa178f8b0e25c883c3c9a8d49e964189b1.gif[/img][/url]

This patch focuses mostly on the look and feel of the game.  Over the past week we've done a lot of changes to improve the quality of the artwork and UI, and fix as many bugs as we can.

- (update) add Global Chat to Home page
- (update) add Recent Matches tab to give some sense of how many players are online
- (update) move patch notes to its own popup
- (update) add stats menu
- (update) remove AI art from splash page, use talking demon gif
- (update) update environmental hellfire
- (update) small UI improvements
- (update) level art improvements
- (update) tweaks to late game neutral animation
- (update) clean up splash screen
- (update) clean up some tower and base animations
- (update) add more little creatures to level
- (update) shorten minion names to reduce screen clutter

- (bug) fix bug where you could use topnav while in popeselect
- (bug) fix bug where WADS keys were not remappable, which broke AZERTY keyboards
- (bug) fix bug where post game menu had no background
- (bug) fix bug that let you use skins
- (bug) fix bug that assigned skins to AI
- (bug) fix bug with starting matches
- (bug) fix bug where tank minion didn't spawn
- (bug) fix bug with Catacomber/Demon Skin walk animation
- (bug) fix a bug with Buy On Steam button
- (bug) fix bug with playing as Pope Urban VI
- (bug) fix bug with PONTIUS spawn height
- (bug) fix visual issues with towers, base
- (bug) fix issues with stats panel
- (bug) fix a bug which made the UI annoying to use via controller on some non-16:9 aspect ratios
- (bug) fix a bug that allowed jumping up and out of the ceiling
- (bug) fix a bug with camera shaking while AI was dead
- (bug) fix a bug with AI showing mouse indicator
